Summary: Docker Compose stack with db, api, worker and web; health endpoint green
Acceptance Criteria: `docker compose up` starts all four services and GET /api/health returns 200 with database and worker status ok

Summary: FastAPI app skeleton with env config, Alembic, pytest harness against Postgres, OpenAPI and import-boundary test
Acceptance Criteria: pytest runs green against the Compose Postgres, /api/docs serves OpenAPI, and a test fails if matching/rules/cases/recovery/reporting import the ai domain

Summary: Vite React TypeScript app with router, typed API client and layout shell with navigation for all eight areas
Acceptance Criteria: `npm run build` and `tsc` pass and the shell renders navigation for all screen areas in Chrome at 1280px

Summary: Canonical data model and initial migration for all entities with source references and decimal money
Acceptance Criteria: Alembic migration creates every entity in design §3.2 with NUMERIC money, currency codes and a unique source key on source-backed tables

Summary: Organization signup, login, and user management with five roles
Acceptance Criteria: Signup creates an org plus admin, login returns a JWT that expires, and an admin can create, re-role and deactivate users

Summary: Permission matrix and tenant scoping on every endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: Each endpoint enforces the design §3.7 matrix and a test per router proves a user of org A gets 404/403 on org B's resources

Summary: Hash-chained audit log with verify endpoint
Acceptance Criteria: State-changing services append audit events in the same transaction and /api/audit/verify detects a tampered event in a test

Summary: Field registry and downloadable CSV templates per record type
Acceptance Criteria: A template download exists for every record type in requirements §5 and is generated from the same registry used for validation

Summary: Data sources, saved field mappings and import profiling
Acceptance Criteria: Uploading a CSV returns a profile with missing required fields, unmapped columns and unmatched references, and a saved mapping is reused for the next upload from the same source

Summary: Import commit with row validation, error report, history and idempotent upsert
Acceptance Criteria: Committing an import records inserted/updated/unchanged/rejected counts with a downloadable error report, and re-importing the same file yields zero inserts

Summary: Postgres job queue and worker with visible failures and retry
Acceptance Criteria: Jobs are claimed with SKIP LOCKED, a failing job shows status failed with its error via the API, and retry re-queues it

Summary: Connector interface and labelled demonstration connector
Acceptance Criteria: A documented connector interface exists and the demo connector loads demo data through the same ingestion path while every API response marks it is_demo

Summary: Run checks now and scheduled refresh
Acceptance Criteria: An authorized user can trigger a check run that executes in the worker, and an org refresh interval causes runs to be enqueued automatically

Summary: Agreements, versions and effective-dated terms with deterministic term resolution
Acceptance Criteria: Tests prove the correct confirmed term is resolved for dates before, within and after amendments, and non-confirmed terms are never returned

Summary: Versioned per-org rule configurations
Acceptance Criteria: Changing a rule config creates a new version, findings record the version used, and each demo org's business-type config is data only

Summary: Delivered-versus-billed matcher across billing periods
Acceptance Criteria: Tests prove correct bucket quantities for split invoices, aggregated lines, partial delivery and monthly/quarterly/per-event frequencies using Decimal only

Summary: Check: delivered but not billed
Acceptance Criteria: A bucket with delivered quantity above billed quantity past billing date plus grace raises a finding valued at missing quantity times expected net price

Summary: Check: incorrect contracted rate
Acceptance Criteria: An invoice line whose net unit price differs from the resolved rate beyond tolerance raises a finding valued net of tax and only within the same currency

Summary: Check: expired or unauthorized discount
Acceptance Criteria: A line discount applied after the discount term's expiry or above the approved percentage raises a finding with the lost value

Summary: Check: missed contractual increase
Acceptance Criteria: A line billed at the pre-escalation rate while an escalation term is effective raises a finding for the difference

Summary: Check: credit outside policy
Acceptance Criteria: A credit without reason code, above threshold without approval reference, or above the policy limit raises a finding

Summary: Finding generation with fingerprint dedup, evidence snapshot and calculation
Acceptance Criteria: Two checks detecting one discrepancy produce one finding listing also_detected_by, re-running checks creates no new findings, and each finding stores value, confidence, reason, calculation, evidence, rule version and next action within 30s for the demo dataset

Summary: Findings queue and detail API with comments and timeline
Acceptance Criteria: The queue is sorted by value times confidence and filters by value, customer, type, confidence, age, owner and status; detail returns evidence, calculation, timeline and comments

Summary: Finding workflow transitions with separation of duties and immutability
Acceptance Criteria: Only design §2.5 transitions succeed, a proposer's approval is refused, and edits to value/evidence of terminal findings are rejected by a database trigger

Summary: Prepared corrections on approval with export
Acceptance Criteria: Approval creates exactly one correction with a unique reference exportable as CSV/JSON, and no code path sends anything externally

Summary: Recovery tracking from correction to billed to cash
Acceptance Criteria: Importing an invoice with the correction reference marks it billed, and only payment allocations to that invoice increase cash recovered, capped at the correction amount

Summary: Root cause, recurrence detection and prevented-recurrence estimate
Acceptance Criteria: A root cause is required to propose, a later run with the same recurrence key flags the new finding as recurrence, and clean later periods add to the prevented-recurrence estimate

Summary: Outcome figures, trends and recurring causes
Acceptance Criteria: The metrics endpoint returns the six figures per design §2.5 with rejected findings excluded from every money figure, plus monthly trend and top root causes

Summary: Pricing opportunities from cost data
Acceptance Criteria: Opportunities are returned only for items with an effective cost record and margin below target, from a separate endpoint never included in leakage figures

Summary: Contract document upload, storage interface and text extraction
Acceptance Criteria: PDF, DOCX and TXT uploads are stored via the DocumentStore interface with sha256 and size/type limits, and their text is extracted

Summary: AI provider interface with stub default and optional Anthropic adapter
Acceptance Criteria: Orgs default to the stub provider, the Anthropic adapter is used only after an audited admin opt-in with a key present, and outputs are schema-validated

Summary: Proposed term extraction with verbatim passage check and ambiguity flag
Acceptance Criteria: Extracted terms are stored as proposed with a passage that is a verbatim substring of the document, ambiguous terms are flagged, and an embedded instruction in a test contract has no effect

Summary: Term confirmation workflow
Acceptance Criteria: An admin or commercial manager can confirm, edit or reject a proposed term with an audit event, and only then does it affect a check run

Summary: AI mapping suggestions and labelled finding summaries
Acceptance Criteria: Mapping suggestions are returned for unmapped headers without being auto-applied, and finding summaries are stored in ai_summary and never read by calculations

Summary: Settings, retention period and organization data deletion
Acceptance Criteria: An admin can set refresh interval, AI provider and retention, and deleting org data removes all its rows and files leaving only a tombstone audit record

Summary: Synthetic demo data for three business types with seed command
Acceptance Criteria: `python -m app.seed_demo` creates the DEMO orgs JM and Beyon with users and data covering three business types that produce all eight acceptance scenarios through configuration only

Summary: Login, session and role-aware navigation
Acceptance Criteria: A demo user can log in, sees only the areas their role permits, and is returned to login when the token expires

Summary: Data setup screen
Acceptance Criteria: An admin can register a source, upload a CSV, review and edit the mapping with suggestions, see the profile, commit, view history and errors, retry failures and run checks now

Summary: Findings queue screen
Acceptance Criteria: The queue shows prioritized findings with all seven filters working against the API

Summary: Finding detail screen with workflow actions
Acceptance Criteria: Detail shows side-by-side evidence, calculation, timeline, comments and labelled AI summary, and offers only the actions the user's role and the finding's status allow

Summary: Recovery tracker screen
Acceptance Criteria: The tracker lists corrections with reference, invoice reference, billed amount, payments and verified outcome, and exports a correction

Summary: Overview dashboard
Acceptance Criteria: The overview shows the six figures as separate labelled values, open findings, monthly trend and top recurring causes

Summary: Rules and agreements screen with term review
Acceptance Criteria: Users see agreements, versions and terms with effective dates and status, can confirm or reject proposed terms beside their source passage, and see rule versions

Summary: Pricing opportunities screen
Acceptance Criteria: Opportunities are shown in their own screen with cost basis and margin, and the screen states when cost data is missing

Summary: Access and settings screen
Acceptance Criteria: An admin can manage users and roles, AI provider, refresh interval and retention, delete org data with confirmation, and view audit history with chain verification

Summary: End-to-end acceptance test for the eight scenarios
Acceptance Criteria: An automated test seeds demo data and asserts all eight scenarios in requirements §11 including timing under 30 seconds

Summary: RUNNING.md, API documentation notes and user-journey walkthrough
Acceptance Criteria: A new developer can run the stack and tests from RUNNING.md alone, and docs/walkthrough.md covers the complete user journey

Summary: Deployment guide with security requirements
Acceptance Criteria: docs/deployment.md states TLS, encryption at rest, secrets management and connector activation steps
